name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-new-customer-packet
title: New Customer Packet
shortDescription: Builds a complete, branded new-customer insurance packet from one application PDF, selected by library metadata and rendered from HTML layouts.
longDescription: Reads one application PDF, fills the customer columns, selects the templates whose columns match the customer's state, coverage and business type, and freezes one ordered manifest.
Renders each document from its HTML layout with the state seal bound from a Seals folder, converts to PDF, merges once, copies the packet to a Completed Packets library and sets the statuses.
Stops with Needs information when a required count is missing. Carries a rulebook (packet-manifest.md) and a field map (template-fields.md) in its references folder.
